# uBlock Origin Lite (bundled with Drift)

- Source: https://github.com/uBlockOrigin/uBOL-home/releases (the `.safari.zip` asset)
- Version here: 2026.1110.1816
- Licence: GPL-3.0 (see `ext/LICENSE.txt`). It is shipped unmodified, as a separate work inside the app bundle.

`ext/` is the unzipped release. `build.sh` copies it to `Drift.app/Contents/Resources/extensions/ubol`.
To update: download the newer `.safari.zip`, replace `ext/` with its contents, rebuild.
